I replied to Pree in a thread on their message in #central-team: the store is **Pine Crossing**.

I found it in #central-team, which Pree is a member of. On June 9, Pree posted that the morning receiver at Pine Crossing said the appointment screen only showed the afternoon shift. A driver had arrived at 7:10 the day before, and staff wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and ask support to reproduce the problem with the store login. There's no update on that in the channel, and I told Pree so.
